title: Ask HN: Anthropic is accusing my company of distilling. How can I prove I'm not?
author: weli
description: Basically the title. Anthropic is accusing me and my company of using their API for distillation. We are not. We do not train our own models. Our only usage which I think could get us flagged is automated regression benchmarks whenever we change some AI settings. But this is not against their policy? Now I've got 24h…
summary: Anthropic is accusing me and my company of using their API for distillation. Our only usage which I think could get us flagged is automated regression benchmarks whenever we change some AI settings.
takeaways: Our only usage which I think could get us flagged is automated regression benchmarks whenever we change some AI settings.
